description: Agent Limits: submit a threshold set as of a date, each threshold with its value, when it was set, who owns its review, its review cadence (such as quarterly, 90 days or none) and its review history (each review with its date, who held it, what it decided, the data it looked at and its rationale), plus the changes to the agent or its work since thresholds were set (a model upgrade, a new merchant, a new task). The signed report names every threshold never reviewed since setup, on no schedule, past its scheduled review, with no named owner, whose last review left no decision, data or rationale, and that the agent or its work has changed around since its last review, with the fix for each. This reads whether thresholds are kept current after setup: whether escalation triggers are operable is wever_escalation-threshold-check and whether consequential actions are gated by a threshold is wever_action-threshold-check. Verdict thresholds_fossilized, review_gaps, review_unverified or reviewed_on_schedule. POST /api/threshold-review-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-limits-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-limits/.

as_of.description: The date the review history runs to.

changes.description: Changes to the agent or its work since thresholds were set.

what.description: What changed, such as a model upgrade or a new merchant.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

thresholds.description: Each threshold with its review history.

cadence.description: How often it is reviewed, such as quarterly, monthly or 90 days, or none.

reviews.description: Each review held, in any order.

data.description: What the review looked at, such as 90 days of breaches.

name: wever_threshold-review-check
title: Threshold review check
